title: Naturality and homotopy-retract diagrams for Roos comparisons
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with countable products. Let $I,J$ be integer-indexed complexes of inverse systems [def-weil-inverse-system], and let $u:I\to J$, $r:J\to I$ be chain maps with $ur$ homotopic to the identity of $I$. Choose product, termwise kernel and signed shifted-cone presentations $(P,L,C,e_P,s,i,e_C,\eta)$ and $(P_J,L_J,C_J,e_{PJ},s_J,i_J,e_{CJ},\eta_J)$: products and their differentials are termwise, $s$ and $s_J$ are the transition endomorphisms [def-weil-tower-transition-endomorphism], kernel forks are limiting, cone differentials are $(y,x)\mapsto(-dy-sx,dx)$, and comparison components are $(0,i)$. There exist chain maps $l_U:L\to L_J$, $c_U:C\to C_J$, $l_R:L_J\to L$, $c_R:C_J\to C$ satisfying $l_U\eta_J=\eta c_U$ and $l_R\eta=\eta_J c_R$, with $l_Ul_R$ homotopic to the identity of $L$ and $c_Uc_R$ homotopic to the identity of $C$. Neither comparison is assumed a quasi-isomorphism; neither tower is assumed K-injective or split.

proof.text: Apply CategoryTheory.roos_comparison_maps to u and then to r with the two supplied presentations reversed. This supplies the four maps, the two squares and the four induced-component equations.

Apply CategoryTheory.roos_comparison_homotopies with hr and those component equations to obtain the two retraction homotopies. Assemble the maps, squares and homotopies into the required existential conjunction.

theorem roos_comparison_homotopy_retract
    (A : Type u) [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    [HasLimitsOfShape (Discrete ℕ) A]
    (I J : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ℤ)
    (u : I ⟶ J) (r : J ⟶ I) (hr : Homotopy (u ≫ r) (𝟙 I))
    (P L C : CochainComplex A ℤ)
    (eP : ∀ p : ℤ, P.X p ≅ ∏ᶜ (fun n : ℕ ↦ (I.X p).obj (Opposite.op n)))
    (hP : ∀ p q : ℤ, P.d p q ≫ (eP q).hom =
      (eP p).hom ≫ Limits.Pi.map (fun n ↦ (I.d p q).app (Opposite.op n)))
    (oneSubS : P ⟶ P)
    (hS : ∀ p : ℤ, oneSubS.f p = (eP p).hom ≫
      towerTransitionEndomorphism
        (fun n ↦ (I.X p).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) ≫ (eP p).inv)
    (iota : L ⟶ P)
    (hKernel : ∀ p : ℤ, iota.f p ≫ oneSubS.f p = 0)
    (hL : ∀ p : ℤ, IsLimit (KernelFork.ofι (iota.f p) (hKernel p)))
    (eC : ∀ p : ℤ, C.X (p + 1) ≅ P.X p ⊞ P.X (p + 1))
    (hC : ∀ p : ℤ, C.d (p + 1) (p + 1 + 1) ≫ (eC (p + 1)).hom =
      (eC p).hom ≫ biprod.lift
        (-(biprod.fst ≫ P.d p (p + 1)) - biprod.snd ≫ oneSubS.f (p + 1))
        (biprod.snd ≫ P.d (p + 1) (p + 1 + 1)))
    (eta : L ⟶ C)
    (hEta : ∀ p : ℤ, eta.f (p + 1) ≫ (eC p).hom =
      biprod.lift 0 (iota.f (p + 1)))
    (PJ LJ CJ : CochainComplex A ℤ)
    (ePJ : ∀ p : ℤ, PJ.X p ≅ ∏ᶜ (fun n : ℕ ↦ (J.X p).obj (Opposite.op n)))
    (hPJ : ∀ p q : ℤ, PJ.d p q ≫ (ePJ q).hom =
      (ePJ p).hom ≫ Limits.Pi.map (fun n ↦ (J.d p q).app (Opposite.op n)))
    (sJ : PJ ⟶ PJ)
    (hSJ : ∀ p : ℤ, sJ.f p = (ePJ p).hom ≫
      towerTransitionEndomorphism
        (fun n ↦ (J.X p).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) ≫ (ePJ p).inv)
    (iJ : LJ ⟶ PJ)
    (hKJ : ∀ p : ℤ, iJ.f p ≫ sJ.f p = 0)
    (hLJ : ∀ p : ℤ, IsLimit (KernelFork.ofι (iJ.f p) (hKJ p)))
    (eCJ : ∀ p : ℤ, CJ.X (p + 1) ≅ PJ.X p ⊞ PJ.X (p + 1))
    (hCJ : ∀ p : ℤ, CJ.d (p + 1) (p + 1 + 1) ≫ (eCJ (p + 1)).hom =
      (eCJ p).hom ≫ biprod.lift
        (-(biprod.fst ≫ PJ.d p (p + 1)) - biprod.snd ≫ sJ.f (p + 1))
        (biprod.snd ≫ PJ.d (p + 1) (p + 1 + 1)))
    (etaJ : LJ ⟶ CJ)
    (hEtaJ : ∀ p : ℤ, etaJ.f (p + 1) ≫ (eCJ p).hom =
      biprod.lift 0 (iJ.f (p + 1)))
    : ∃ (lU : L ⟶ LJ) (cU : C ⟶ CJ) (lR : LJ ⟶ L) (cR : CJ ⟶ C),
      lU ≫ etaJ = eta ≫ cU ∧ lR ≫ eta = etaJ ≫ cR ∧
      Nonempty (Homotopy (lU ≫ lR) (𝟙 L)) ∧
      Nonempty (Homotopy (cU ≫ cR) (𝟙 C))
